name: Symptoms Text Block
description:
A failing fan almost always warns you first. If any of these sound familiar, plan the replacement before the motor seizes completely.

  • The fan stays silent when the cabin powers up
  • Rattling, grinding or clicking coming from the vent grille
  • Weak airflow, and a cabin that stays humid long after a session
  • The fan runs only at full speed, or cuts out mid-session
  • A hot, dusty or burning smell near the vent
  • The control panel reports a fan, airflow or over-temperature error
